output.summary: A herbaceous perennial native across parts of South, East and Southeast Asia, it has broad heart-shaped leaves and small greenish-yellow flowers framed by white bracts. Its fishy-tasting leaves are eaten fresh or cooked, while tender roots and rhizomes are used in regional Asian dishes; dried leaves may be brewed as tea.
